tasks.title: usePreviewStateStore — ephemeral per-node edits
tasks.haltCheck: usePreviewStateStore exports set(nodeId,patch), commit(nodeId), discard(nodeId), peek(nodeId), and isDirty(nodeId). Pure in-memory state; no persistence. Unit tests cover all four ops.

Implementation: zustand store with subscribeWithSelector middleware, patches: Record<nodeId, Partial<PrismNode>> as the single state slice. set merges via spread (prev existing patch || empty) so multi-set on the same nodeId composes additively (Inspector tab faders trickle in independent fields); empty-object set is a no-op (does not flip isDirty). commit returns the current patch and deletes only that nodeId's entry (SC-073 single-node clear, not bulk). discard mirrors commit minus the return. discardAll is a teardown-only helper (afterEach in the test). peek returns Partial<PrismNode> | null; isDirty is boolean. Pure in-memory: no localStorage / IndexedDB / fetch / file I/O. The 14 tests cover surface presence, set/peek/merge/isolation, isDirty truthy+falsy+empty-patch-noop, commit return + single-node clear + clean-noop + isolation, discard single + clean-noop, and no-localStorage purity.
